# CANDIDATE: NAMED_LEVEL_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
Price tends to find support at prior‑day named levels when it pulls back to VWAP, offering a low‑risk long entry. This setup captures intraday mean-reversion to VWAP at significant horizontal levels, combining level respect with VWAP-aligned momentum for asymmetric risk-reward.

## Mechanism
Entry: When price is within 0.15% of a named level (prior day high, prior day low, weekly high, weekly low) AND close of the bar is above VWAP AND bar body >60% of total range (conviction candle) AND volume >1.2× 20-bar average volume → enter long at open of next bar.
Exit: Initial stop at low of entry bar. Target at 1.5R. Upon reaching 1R profit, move stop to break-even and trail with 15-period chandelier exit. Regime filter: Only active 10:00-11:30 ET when VIX between 12-20, avoiding FOMC/CPI/news windows and when price below 8-EMA (strong bearish ribbon).
